## 1. nw-web-i18n (northwind/nw-web-i18n@8f4b35c04bd7) # Web Internationalization All user-visible strings in web pages must use the `t()` helper instead of hardcoded text: ```tsx import { t } from '@/lib/i18n'

{t('orders.heading')}

``` - Key format: `.` (e.g. `orders.heading`, `settings.save_button`). - Every key must exist in BOTH `locales/en.json` and `locales/ko.json`. - No hardcoded user-visible strings in JSX. ## Good Example ```tsx import { t } from '../lib/i18n'

{t('orders.heading')}

{t('orders.empty_state')}

``` locales/en.json: `{ "orders": { "heading": "Orders", "empty_state": "No orders yet." } }` locales/ko.json: `{ "orders": { "heading": "주문", "empty_state": "주문이 없습니다." } }` ## Bad Example ```tsx

Orders

No orders yet.

``` Hardcoded English strings that cannot be localized. ## Why All Northwind web products must support English and Korean for our dual-market user base. ## 2. nw-ui-tokens (northwind/nw-ui-tokens@005cc5740010) # UI Design Tokens All colors and spacing in new or modified styles must use `var(--nw-*)` CSS custom properties: ```css color: var(--nw-color-primary); padding: var(--nw-spacing-md); ``` - No raw hex color values (e.g. `#0066cc`). - No raw pixel spacing values (e.g. `16px` for layout spacing). Use `--nw-spacing-*` tokens. - Token definitions are in `styles/tokens.css`. ## Good Example ```tsx
``` ## Bad Example ```tsx
``` ## Why Design tokens enable theme-wide changes from a single source and ensure visual consistency across the application. ## 3. nw-changelog (northwind/nw-changelog@72d8f1872e37) # Changelog Fragments Every user-facing change must create a changelog fragment file: changes/-.md - `` is one of: `feat`, `fix`, `chore`. - `` is a short kebab-case identifier for the change. - The file body is a one-line description of the change. ## Good Example `changes/feat-refund-endpoint.md`: ```markdown Added POST /refunds endpoint for processing order refunds. ``` ## Bad Example Committing a new feature without creating a changelog fragment. ## Why Fragment-based changelogs prevent merge conflicts and enable automated release note generation. 주문 내역 페이지를 추가해 주세요. /orders 경로에서 주문 목록을 보여주는 페이지입니다.
